items.text: The tasks look similar on paper, but the pace and the stakes differ.
Most people enter through operations or patient services.
Sports roles are often won through volunteering and proof.
These are rated for how far your own effort can scale beyond a salary.
Local demand for well-run events, training and services can support a growing company.
